items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is not an insured peril under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. The items are also excluded as personal property carried in a vehicle away from the insured location under §§4.3(d)–(f) and 4.5, so nothing is payable before any deductible.
The car is excluded under §4.3(e), and §5.2.5 expressly excludes vehicle-related expenditure. There is no insured building loss to which this charge could be allocated, so nothing is payable.
